title: Wharness Local Repository Topology v1
description: Which repositories a project is actually made of: the superproject and every Git submodule reachable from an index. Attached to a planner request as the LOCAL REPOSITORY TOPOLOGY section, and only when the project has submodules at all — publishing it for an ordinary single-repository project would spend context restating what the planner already assumes. It is a Wharnex measurement and is descriptive only: routing a path to the repository that owns it is performed by Wharnex whether or not the planner reads this, no plan field selects a repository, and nothing here grants a capability or relaxes a check. See adr/ADR-0050.

units.description: The superproject first, then every submodule ordered by nesting depth.

warnings.description: Units Wharnex could not measure, so a planner reading an incomplete inventory knows it is incomplete.

path.description: The unit's worktree root, relative to the project. Empty for the superproject. Every path in a plan and in a patch stays project-relative whichever unit owns it; this value exists so a planner can tell which repository a path belongs to, never so it can address one.

head.description: The unit's current commit. Absent for a repository with no commit yet.

branch.description: The checked-out branch. Absent when detached, which is the ordinary resting state of a submodule rather than a fault.

initialized.description: Whether a submodule has a checkout at all. An uninitialized submodule is an empty directory.

registered.description: Whether .gitmodules still describes it. A gitlink whose .gitmodules entry was removed is still a gitlink to merge and status.

recorded_commit.description: The gitlink the parent's index holds for this unit. It is a commit id, not content: never patch it.

patchable.description: Whether a patch writing here can be verified and integrated. False means the change cannot be delivered at those paths at all, whatever the patch says, and such a bundle is rejected at ingestion.
